note: What the page asks back, and the keyword map it uses to read a free-text note. Matching is literal substring matching on a lower-cased string: no model, no randomness, no inference. A phrase that matches nothing is still recorded and the page does not claim it changed anything.

questions.text: Can you work shifts, including nights?
Would you move to another city for the right role?
Do you hold a driving licence?
Are you open to a fixed-term contract to start?

effects.shift_work: Listings flagged requires_shift_work score full context fit when yes, little when no, and sit at 0.6 while unanswered.
effects.mobility: Raises the floor on city fit from 0.4 to 0.8, so another city stops being a penalty.
effects.licence: Listings flagged requires_licence behave as above, and yes also closes the driving-licence gap.
effects.fixed_term: Listings whose contract_type is fixed_term behave as above.
